# IBOL Open Learning Companion

> Reading, teaching and citation resources for Albert Tan Sin Hon’s open-access book on financial law, insurance and trust governance at the PRC–Hong Kong interface.

Published 6 November 2026 by University of Groningen Press. DOI: 10.21827/6ac3948159a9e. The book’s legal cut-off is 1 August 2026. Companion summaries and exercises are separate, AI-assisted teaching materials commissioned by the author. The published book is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; original companion teaching materials are CC BY 4.0 and code is MIT. This file is a navigation convention, not a guarantee of indexing or recommendation.

## Book and provenance
- [Published book](https://books.ugp.rug.nl/ugp/catalog/book/300)
- [Bibliographic and source record](https://www.alberttansinhon.com/ibol/data/book.json)
- [Rights and attribution](https://www.alberttansinhon.com/ibol/RIGHTS.md)
